title: Serene Home, Heated Pool & Games
description: This serene home can fit up to 22 guests with its 7 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. With lots of upscale amenities and a stunning heated pool and spa in the backyard, this home is your ultimate travel destination. Filled with sunlight and professionally selected décor, this airy and classy home is custom-designed for large groups to experience extravagant living. The professionally designed spaces offer open-concept layouts and kitchen & dining spaces perfect for entertaining.
